rules.title: Algorithmic rent fixing in rental housing market prohibited
rules.quote: Landlords who rent any residential dwelling unit (defined as any primary residence excluding medical/long-term care or detention facilities) in the City of Hoboken are prohibited from price fixing using algorithmic pricing. For purposes of this chapter, "price fixing using algorithmic pricing" shall be defined as the use of software, algorithms, or data-sharing platforms to collect and analyze nonpublic competitor information from other real estate lessors in order to coordinate, recommend, or implement rental prices, lease terms, or occupancy levels for residential dwelling units among competing real estate lessors.
rules.summary: Landlords are prohibited from using software, algorithms, or data-sharing platforms to collect and analyze nonpublic competitor information to coordinate or set rental prices, lease terms, or occupancy levels.
rules.coverage_text: any residential dwelling unit (defined as any primary residence excluding medical/long-term care or detention facilities) in the City of Hoboken
rules.penalty: Fine not exceeding $2,000, or community service not exceeding 90 days, or penalties as prescribed under N.J.S.A. 40:49-5
